id: title:hpouillot:offer a presigned put for symbol set uploads

review.posthog_relevance: Adds presigned PUT URL support to the object storage client and bulk upload API, compatible with S3-compatible stores lacking presigned POST support, while including tests for URL omission and transfer acceleration. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only maintenance.

observations.behavior: Adds a new abstract method and its implementation for presigned PUT URL generation in the object storage client.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the backend to generate presigned PUT URLs for uploading symbol sets, which is compatible with S3-compatible stores that do not support presigned POST (e.g., Cloudflare R2).

observations.behavior: Adds a new abstract method and its implementation for presigned PUT URL generation in the object storage client.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the backend to generate presigned PUT URLs for uploading symbol sets, which is compatible with S3-compatible stores that do not support presigned POST (e.g., Cloudflare R2).

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only backend tests and frontend API schema definitions. No implementation, configuration, or shared backend service changes are supplied, so tier and score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting presigned PUT URL is omitted when no content_length is provided.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the bulk upload API response; without a supplied byte count, the backend should not return a presigned PUT, preserving compatibility with S3-compatible stores that lack PUT support.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting presigned PUT URL is returned and includes content-length when content_length is supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the backend honors the declared byte count and returns a presigned PUT with a Content-Length header, enabling S3-compatible stores without presigned POST support.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting presigned PUT URL includes s3-accelerate when transfer acceleration is enabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the presigned PUT URL respects the transfer acceleration setting, allowing use of S3-accelerate endpoints.
